 Attend Holiday Bazaar at Lake Oswego High School
 Published 5:00 am Saturday, November 14, 2026
 By Corey Buchanan 
 1/2 
 Swipe or click to see more 
 The bazaar will be held from 10 a.m. to 4 p.m. Saturday, Nov. 28 at Lake Oswego High School. 
 (Jennifer Plaster Waddell/Courtesy)

 There will be 80 artisan vendors at the event.

 Getting your Trinity Audio player ready... 
 The Lake Oswego High School Holiday Bazaar is right around the corner.
 This year’s market, held from 10 a.m. to 4 p.m. Saturday, Nov. 28 at the school, will feature holiday gift possibilities from local artists and raise money for the school’s ceramics department so students can purchase needed equipment. The event is free to attend.
 In the past, the department has bought slab rollers and pottery wheels. This year, students are raising money for a pug mill mixer. There will be 80 artisan vendors and a raffle.
 “There’s something really beautiful about seeing our community come together to shop small, support local makers, and give back to our school. It’s also a chance for the student artists to see that the things they love making today can continue to be part of their lives long after high school,” said volunteer coordinator Jennifer Plaster Waddell.
